name: The Balance of Nature
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Thinning the younger population of creatures here in Shadowglen was a good start, adventurer, but there is still work to be done.

The resources of the forest will be depleted too quickly if the problem is not addressed.  Killing nature's beasts is a necessary evil for the good of all who share the land.  Venture into the forest and slay mangy nightsabers and thistle boars in the name of balance.
narrative.objectives: Conservator Ilthalaine needs you to kill 7 Mangy Nightsabers and 7 Thistle Boars.
narrative.offerRewardText: You have proven your dedication to nature well, adventurer. A young Champion like yourself has a promising future.
narrative.requestItemsText: Your task is not yet complete, adventurer. Return to me once 7 mangy nightsabers and 7 thistle boars have been killed.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 2 to 3, 420 XP in all.

quests.name: The Balance of Nature
quests.objectiveText: Kill 7 Young Nightsabers and 4 Young Thistle Boars and return to Conservator Ilthalaine.
